LESSON: WRITING 12.4.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING: DIARY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.4: Writing 12.4.1 Functional Writing: Diary

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 12.4.1 Functional Writing: Diary. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we plan our activities in advance?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the key components of a diary/journal from a sample diary/journal
2. create a journal/diary to convey desired information in the right format

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 12.4.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING: DIARY
This lesson teaches Writing 12.4.1 Functional Writing: Diary for Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the key components of a diary/journal from a sample diary/journal
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. create a journal/diary to convey desired information in the right format
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 12.4.1 Functional Writing: Diary using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 12.4.1 Functional Writing: Diary above.
2. Explain Writing 12.4.1 Functional Writing: Diary to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 12.4.1 Functional Writing: Diary.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 12.4.1 Functional Writing: Diary with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 12.4.1 Functional Writing: Diary important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we plan our activities in advance?
2. What is the most memorable experience in your life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the key components of a diary/journal from a sample diary/journal
2. create a journal/diary to convey desired information in the right format

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
